title: Empty a capsule coffee machine's collector and load a fresh capsule
instruction: Clear the used capsules into the recycling tub and restore the coffee machine with its collection bin fitted, the fresh capsule correctly seated, and its head fully closed. Release both hands when finished.
context: Emptying the used-capsule container and loading the next pod are familiar steps of using a capsule coffee machine. The robot must eject the used pod, handle and empty a loose collector, refit it, then seat the fresh capsule and close the loading head. Nespresso Atelier documents this lever/ejection/container procedure: https://www.nespresso.com/qa/en/machine-assistance/atelier-machine-assistance .
setup: Calibrated two-arm YAM station and parallel grippers. Anchored capsule coffee machine: dark polymer housing with metal carrier/fork, rear empty reservoir, front coffee outlet and drip grille. Complete closed appliance envelope approximately 322 x 240 x 290 mm; housing 280 x 210 x 290 mm. Fixed body 2.8 kg; passive 220 g head with Y-axis hinge at (0.550,0,0.9825) m, 0–85 degrees. Removable polymer collector: 120 x 82 x 65 mm inside, 2 mm walls, 65 g, front bar 30 x 55 x 24 mm; root (0.485,0,0.7575) m. Six spent capsules in a 3 x 2 collector layer and one in the carrier. Reusable aluminum/polymer capsule envelopes: body diameter24–33 mm, height26 mm, flange diameter37 mm; spent12 g, fresh8 g. Fresh capsule at (0.560,0.250,0.8175) m on a fixed70 mm polymer stand. Fixed green polymer recycling tray on left: 300 x 300 x 55 mm inside, root (0.370,0.270,0.7475) m. Reservoir, outlet, grille, hinge ears/shaft, carrier beams/risers, guides and all exact dimensions/poses are listed in README, setup-layout.json and the generated CAD inventory. Printable parts, dimension drawings and assembly specifications: reconstruction/BUILD.md.
scoring: 0.35: all seven used capsules contained at rest in recycling tray. 0.65: collector also fitted within 9 mm, upright cosine >0.99. 1: fresh seated within 3.5 mm horizontally/3 mm vertically and upright cosine >0.99; head <4 degrees closed; loose bodies below 15 mm/s and stable within 2 mm/2 degrees over 1 s; grippers open >40 mm and robot bodies >3 mm clear for 1 s. Drop/invalid: 0.
reset_notes: Restore all bodies and passive joints to the fixed reset and settle before scoring. No consumables in simulation.
fidelity: The cold coffee machine uses native rigid contacts, a passive 0–85 degree head hinge, lifting fork, removable collector and real-size capsule envelopes. The fork lifts and gravity-ejects the used capsule. Printable parts specify the collector, carrier, hinge bearing and mechanical stops; the native revolute joint represents the internal bearing/stop hardware. This trial covers mechanical clearing and reloading; the heater, pump and water circuit are inactive.
